title: LRU cache hits
prompt: The input is pair(c, reqs): a cache capacity c >= 1 and a list of page requests. The cache starts empty. For each request p in order: if p is in the cache it is a hit and p becomes the most recently used page; otherwise it is a miss and p is added as the most recently used page, and if the cache then holds more than c pages, the least recently used page is evicted. Return the number of hits.
